# The Seoulful Edit

> An independent K-beauty and wellness magazine for US readers and visitors to Korea. We pick products using US sales rankings, Korean store data and official ingredient lists, and we say where each product is sold (US or Korea only).

About the editors: An independent K-beauty and wellness magazine led by a Seoul-based beauty marketer with 16 years in the Korean beauty industry. We read sales data, labels and store shelves so you do not have to.
